is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae complex.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers. It mentions kdr mutations in the background (e.g., page 2, 3), but does not provide genotype counts or frequencies for the current study's samples.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided for the mosquitoes used in the study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-caught Anopheles coluzzii from Auyo, Nigeria.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study investigating PAH metabolism by microsomes and recombinant P450s.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies Auyo town, Auyo Local Government, Jigawa State, Nigeria (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected in September 2019 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses a new collection from 2019, although it references previous work on the same Auyo population.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data for the study's findings (metabolism assays) are presented in the main figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the metabolic activity of microsomes from field-collected Anopheles coluzzii (Auyo, Nigeria) and recombinant P450s towards PAHs (fluorene, fluoranthene, naphthalene). It does not report genotype data for resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report genotype data for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided for the mosquitoes used in the study.
